question: Does the useful partial-state channel survive more varied training and comparison with ordinary CoT at equal total updates?
motivation: The complete frozen128-model DEV result establishes student-note utility but used twice the updates and models of compact CoT. Both writer reliability and reader completion remain limited.
initialization: Fresh unchanged B0 for every model and seed; no fitting-model warm starts

training_data.labels: Exact prefix-computable non-root states; ordinary full CoT adds the root equation. No future-aware LM teacher.

matching.limitation: Same shapes/updates approximate compute. Measure supervised tokens, chip-time, actual generated tokens and latency; account for two full models in C.

optimization.loss: Mean completion CE per example, then global mean over examples. Ordinary CoT treats its full completion as one component.

reader_schedule: Every expression gets one teacher and one plain view across two passes; aggregate50%teacher/25%empty/25%direct. Both seed schedules already exhaustively CPU audited.

endpoints.primary: Terminal complete-answer accuracy on each separate512-item interpolation/structure/range/composition DEV panel.
endpoints.uncertainty: Paired question bootstrap5000/seed17 within each panel. Keep seed outcomes separate; do not pool panels or count conditions as independent items.
endpoints.primary_checkpoint: Terminal320 for each split component; terminal640 for each single-model comparator. No best-checkpoint selection.
endpoints.reporting: All writer failures, caps and unsupported answers retained. Canonical-state correctness and stopping are diagnostics; complete answers are primary.

decision_rule: Generated notes must beat same-reader raw/empty/unrelated controls to establish the channel at this budget. Claim practical superiority only where matched single-model competitors and actual costs support it. If ordinary CoT matches or wins, prefer it. Report every panel and both seeds.
development_limit: These synthetic DEV panels have now been inspected for the128-model precursor and informed this follow-up. This is development evidence, not a pristine final test or broad language-model claim. Official TEST remains unopened.

recovery_and_release.first_model: reader seed2026101806, halt after64 with a full checkpoint
requirements: Integrate the already CPU-reviewed v7 source and complete repository checks
Verify actual disk reserve and a protected complete optimizer-state destination
Independently verify full64 then fresh-process exact state restore and ordered continuation before releasing later models
Bound and monitor host memory; run one training arm at a time; no automatic retry loop

capacity_decision: Continue at1.7B because useful fresh computation exists. An8B change remains a separate adapter/sharding/inference qualification, not a model-name substitution.
